verdict: KKR's Q2 revenue rose 13% to $5.7B on record fee earnings and steady insurance income, but $3.3B of insurance benefit payments kept GAAP profit at $660M.

otherDetail: Other income of $661M is KKR's own investment result outside the revenue lines: $404M of net investment gains, $227M of dividends and $733M of interest income, minus $703M of interest expense on KKR's borrowings. After $246M of tax, $74M went to others — $54M to redeemable noncontrolling interests and $40M of preferred dividends, partly offset by a $20M loss borne by noncontrolling interests — leaving $660M for common stockholders.
oneTimers: KKR closed its acquisition of Arctos Partners (sports-franchise investing, $20B of AUM) on June 30, 2026 — it is reported inside Private Equity from this quarter.
footerNote: KKR had not yet reported Q3 2026 as of November 7, 2026, so this page covers its latest reported quarter, Q2 2026. Adaptation: for an asset manager that also owns an insurer, insurance policy benefits and claims ($3,309M) play the role of cost of revenue, compensation is the biggest running cost, and KKR's own investment income ($661M net) is shown below the operating line — GAAP pre-tax income was $981M. Headline non-GAAP measures (fee-related earnings, adjusted net income) exclude unrealized gains and equity pay and are much higher than GAAP profit.

takeaways.title: Fees set a record
takeaways.text: Fee-related earnings hit a record $1.2B ($1.32 per adjusted share), up 37%, and total operating earnings were $1.5B. Management fees grew as fee-paying AUM reached $638B.

takeaways.title: Money kept coming in
takeaways.text: Assets under management rose 16% to $796B, with $34B of new capital raised in the quarter and $133B over twelve months — and the quarter was KKR's strongest ever for returning capital to clients.

takeaways.title: GAAP profit is the noisy number
takeaways.text: GAAP net income for common stockholders was $660M, after $3,309M of insurance benefit payments and $703M of interest expense on KKR's own balance sheet. Adjusted net income — KKR's preferred lens — was a record $1,493M.
